column13: STRUCTURAL: 'CO/prov returns to normal' is not evidence of repair — it is evidence of NOT CURRENTLY BEING EXTREME, which is every bank's default state. The measure is excellent as a STATE DESCRIPTOR (it found the 99th percentile) and bad as a KILL. K-3's kill cell is UNSET WITH A STATED REQUIREMENT (base rate <~10%, not breached at write time, low spurious-fire history, latency <=2-3 quarters, second-reader base-rated). An honest gap beats a falsifier that retires theses at random.
